rationale: NIST AI RMF 1.0 MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE outcomes support the stated intended-context, knowledge-limit, data/TEVV, and recovery/change themes. The claim is confined to the voluntary cross-sector 1.0 framework and does not make it a safety threshold or certification criterion.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-001-R1 through S-EVID-001-R3, NIST AI 100-1, PDF pp. 26-32
limitations: Retain the version number and refresh status because AI RMF 1.0 is being revised.
The RMF supplies no transport risk threshold or evidence that a particular road or aircraft system is safe.
